g.text: Trip State Machine + Atomic Driver Claim
Left: valid trip transitions. Right: two concurrent claims, only one wins.
only reachable from requested or matched --
never from in_progress: a trip already under way
completes or the driver reports it, it doesn't vanish.
Whichever UPDATE's WHERE clause still matches wins the
row -- the database's own row-level locking makes this
atomic; no separate distributed lock is needed here.
